modules.title: 新版本怎样先经过三道关键探针

items.title: 快速评估当前构建的基本可用性
items.text: 首页打不开或登录完全失败时，继续跑几十条细节用例通常只会制造噪声。冒烟测试选择最基本、最关键的少量检查，尽早发现版本是否明显不可用。

items.title: 失败时要有明确阻断动作
items.text: 一项关键探针失败，就记录版本和现象，先修复或回退测试环境中的版本。通过冒烟不等于质量已经足够，只表示值得继续做更深入检查。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 冒烟测试不是完整回归测试，也不是只看服务有没有启动。它检查少量关键用户或系统能力，目标是快速决定继续还是阻断，而不是证明所有旧功能都没受影响。

lessonPractice.title: 新构建部署后，首页打不开。团队下一步最合适的是？

options.label: 记录版本和失败现象，先阻断完整回归，修复后再从冒烟测试开始
options.feedback: 对。首页是关键探针，失败说明当前版本不值得继续投入更深测试。

options.label: 继续运行所有支付、筛选和设置用例，最后再看首页
options.feedback: 系统最基本入口已失败，后续大量结果难以解释且浪费时间。

options.label: 判定所有回归用例均未通过
options.feedback: 只凭首页失败不能判断所有旧功能；先把当前版本阻断并定位。

en.title: After a new build deploys, the home page will not open. What should the team do next?

options.label: Record the version and failure, block the full regression run, fix it, then restart from smoke tests
options.feedback: Correct. A failed key probe means this version is not worth deeper test investment yet.

options.label: Run every payment, filtering, and settings case first, then revisit the home page
options.feedback: The basic entry is already broken, so many later results are hard to interpret and waste time.

options.label: Declare that every historical feature has regressed
options.feedback: One failed home page cannot establish that every old feature failed; block and locate the current version first.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 每次部署到测试环境后先跑冒烟测试：首页能打开、能登录、核心接口有响应。任一项失败就停止后续回归，记录版本和失败证据；三项都通过才继续。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: After every deployment to the test environment, run smoke tests: home opens, login works, and the core API responds. If any fails, stop later regression, record the version and evidence; continue only when all three pass.

learning.assumes: You know a new version can fail at basic startup or login.
learning.outcome: You can select a few probes whose failure should block later checks.

modules.title: How a new version passes three key probes first

items.title: Decide whether deeper work is worthwhile
items.text: If home cannot open or login wholly fails, dozens of detailed cases mostly create noise. Smoke tests select the few basic, critical capabilities that expose an obviously unusable version early.

items.title: A failure needs a blocking action
items.text: Record the version and symptom, then fix or replace the test-environment version. Passing smoke does not mean enough quality; it only means deeper testing is worthwhile.

modules.title: What it is not
modules.text: Smoke testing is neither full regression nor merely checking that a service started. It checks a few critical abilities to decide continue or block, not to prove every old feature remains intact.

distinctions.label: Regression test
distinctions.text: A {c:smoke-test} uses a few key paths to decide quickly whether a new build is worth deeper testing. A {c:regression-test} more broadly checks that a change did not break existing behavior.
